common.comingSoon: Coming soon. This part of Muvo arrives in a later version.

welcome.title: Welcome to Muvo
welcome.subtitle: Your CointMU wallet. Your keys stay on this phone.

create.title: Creating your wallet
create.progress: Generating your recovery phrase and keys. This can take a few seconds.
create.error: Couldn't create the wallet. Please try again.

backup.title: Your recovery phrase
backup.subtitle: Write these words down in order and keep them offline. Anyone who has them can take your funds, and nobody can recover them for you.

verify.title: Check your backup
verify.subtitle: Enter these words from your recovery phrase.
verify.incorrect: That word doesn't match. Check what you wrote down.

import.title: Import a wallet
import.invalidMnemonic: That isn't a valid 12- or 24-word recovery phrase.
import.invalidPrivateKey: That isn't a valid private key.
import.privateKeyWarningBody: A wallet imported from a private key has no recovery phrase. The key is stored only on this phone. If you lose the phone or reset the app without your own backup of the key, the funds are gone.
import.privateKeyAck: I have my own backup of this private key
import.error: Couldn't import the wallet. Please try again.

setPin.subtitle: You'll use it to unlock Muvo and approve transactions.
setPin.error: Couldn't save your PIN. Please try again.
setPin.biometricsBody: Use your fingerprint or face to unlock Muvo. Your PIN always works too.

recover.title: We couldn't read your wallet
recover.body: The wallet data on this device couldn't be read, so it was removed to keep you safe. Your funds are still on the CointMU network. Import your recovery phrase or private key to get access back.

lock.title: Enter your PIN
lock.lockedOut: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{time}}.
lock.resetHint: Forgot your PIN? You can reset this wallet and restore it with your recovery phrase.
lock.biometricsTurnedOff: Biometric unlock was turned off because none is set up on this phone anymore. Use your PIN.

error.not-available: Biometrics aren't available on this phone right now. Use your PIN.
error.not-enrolled: No fingerprint or face is set up on this phone. Add one in your phone's settings, then try again.
error.lockout: Too many failed tries, so your phone locked biometrics. Unlock the phone with its passcode, then try again, or use your PIN.
error.unsupported-build: Face ID works in the installed app, not in Expo Go.
error.failed: That didn't work. Try again or use your PIN.

reset.confirmBody: This deletes the wallet from this phone. Without your recovery phrase or private key, the funds are lost.

balance.label: Total balance
balance.error: Can't reach the CointMU network right now. Pull down to refresh or try again.

transactions.title: Recent activity
transactions.emptyHint: Transactions you send from Muvo appear here.

history.title: History

detail.title: Transaction
detail.feeUnknown: Known once the transaction is mined
detail.missing: This transaction isn't in your history on this device.

history.help: Shows the last 7 days of transfers for this account, plus everything sent from Muvo. Transfers made by smart contracts on your behalf (internal transfers) don't appear here.
history.empty: No transactions in the last 7 days.
history.error: Couldn't load your history from the CointMU network.
history.end: That's everything from the last 7 days.

network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Which CointMU node Muvo talks to. Your keys never leave this phone; a node only sees your public address and the requests Muvo sends.
network.nodesFooter: Muvo only switches to a node that reports chain ID {{chainId}}. Pull down or tap Ping all to check again.
network.refusedUnreachable: Couldn't reach that node. Muvo keeps using the current one.
network.refusedWrongChain: That node is on chain {{chainId}}, not CointMU ({{expected}}). Muvo keeps using the current one.
network.addHint: Use https://. Plain http:// is blocked in release builds.
network.invalidUrl: Enter an http:// or https:// URL.
network.alreadyListed: That node is already in the list.
network.addWarning: Only add nodes you trust. A node sees your address and the transactions you send, and a dishonest one can show false balances. It can never move your funds.
network.limitReached: The list holds at most {{max}} nodes. Remove one of yours to add another.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.addHint: New accounts come from your recovery phrase, so it restores all of them.
accounts.privateKeyHint: This wallet was imported from a private key, so it has no recovery phrase to create more accounts from. To use several accounts, use a wallet with a recovery phrase.
accounts.addFailed: Couldn't add an account. Please try again.

security.title: Security
security.autoLockDesc: Lock Muvo after it has been in the background this long; you then need your PIN again.
security.recoveryPhraseDesc: The words that restore your wallet
security.backupFooter: Both ask for your PIN or biometrics first and block screenshots.
security.recoveryPhraseNone: This wallet has no recovery phrase
security.privateKeyDesc: The key of the active account
security.privateKeyOnlyBackup: The only backup of this wallet
security.attemptsDesc: After {{free}} wrong PINs in a row Muvo makes you wait, longer each time. After {{limit}} it offers to reset the wallet. The right PIN clears the count.

changePin.title: Change PIN
changePin.currentSubtitle: Wrong attempts count toward the lockout.
changePin.newSubtitle: 6 digits. You'll use it to unlock Muvo and approve transactions.
changePin.error: Couldn't save the new PIN. Your old PIN still works. Please try again.

recoveryPhrase.title: Recovery phrase
recoveryPhrase.description: Your recovery phrase restores full access to this wallet.
recoveryPhrase.warning: Never share your recovery phrase. Anyone who has it can take full control of your wallet and steal all of your funds. Store it offline and never type it into a website.
recoveryPhrase.autoHide: The words hide again after 30 seconds, when you leave this screen and when Muvo goes to the background.
recoveryPhrase.privateKey: This wallet was imported from a private key, so it has no recovery phrase. Keep your own backup of the key: it is the only way to restore this wallet.
recoveryPhrase.masked: Hidden. Tap the eye to show the words.

logout.title: Log out
logout.lockNowDesc: Lock Muvo until you enter your PIN. Nothing is deleted.
logout.removeDesc: Deletes the keys from this phone. You need your recovery phrase to get the wallet back.

removeWallet.title: Remove wallet
removeWallet.warningTitle: Make sure you have your recovery phrase
removeWallet.warning: This action is irreversible. If you have not backed up your recovery phrase or private key, your funds will be lost forever. CointMU cannot recover them for you.
removeWallet.description: This permanently removes all accounts and keys from this device. Your funds stay on the CointMU network; you can restore the wallet later with your recovery phrase or private key.
removeWallet.ack: I have my recovery phrase or private key written down
removeWallet.authSubtitle: to remove the wallet from this phone

about.title: About
about.reportIssueDesc: Send a bug report or feature request
about.licenseDesc: Open source under the MIT License
about.disclaimer: Muvo is a non-custodial wallet. Your keys stay on this phone, and nobody, including us, can recover them for you.
about.copyBuildInfoDesc: Paste it into a bug report. It holds no wallet data.
about.testErrorDesc: Development only. Sends a sample report with fake secrets to check that they arrive redacted.
about.testErrorQueued: Test report saved. It is sent when the server can be reached.
about.testErrorOff: Nothing was sent: error reporting is off or not set up.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.accentDesc: Used for buttons, links and highlights.
appearance.textSizeDesc: Text grows with the size set in your phone's settings. Off keeps Muvo's standard size.
appearance.motionDesc: Automatic turns them off when your phone asks for reduced motion.
appearance.timeFormatDesc: How times are shown in history.
appearance.decimalsDesc: Decimal places of balances. Full shows the exact amount. What you send is always shown in full.
appearance.hideZeroDesc: Tokens with a zero balance stay off the home screen. CMU always shows.
appearance.privacyFooter: The recovery phrase and private key screens always block screenshots, whatever is set here.
appearance.hideBalancesDesc: Show •••• instead of amounts. Tap the eye on the home screen to see them for 30 seconds. The amount you are about to send is always shown.
appearance.hideInSwitcher: Hide Muvo in the app switcher
appearance.hideInSwitcherDesc: Cover the screen whenever Muvo is not the app in front.
appearance.hideInSwitcherDescAndroid: Cover the screen whenever Muvo is not the app in front. On Android this also blocks screenshots of Muvo.

language.title: Language
language.footer: Applies right away. Muvo starts in this language next time.

biometrics.title: Biometric unlock
biometrics.noHardware: This phone has no fingerprint or face sensor.
biometrics.notEnrolled: Nothing is set up yet. Add a fingerprint or face in your phone's settings, then come back.
biometrics.description: Unlock Muvo, approve sends and reveal backups without typing your PIN. Your PIN always works too.
biometrics.confirmBody: One successful check turns it on. Your PIN keeps working.
biometrics.unavailable: {{name}} isn't available on this phone right now. Check your phone's settings.
biometrics.turnedOffBody: No fingerprint or face is set up on this phone anymore, so Muvo went back to PIN only. Set one up in your phone's settings, then turn it on again here.

privateKey.title: Private key
privateKey.scopeImported: This wallet was imported from a private key, so it has no recovery phrase. This key is the only way to restore it. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe and offline.
privateKey.scopePhrase: This is the key of {{account}} only. Your recovery phrase restores every account, so back that up first.
privateKey.warning: Anyone who has it gains full control of this account and can steal all of its funds. CointMU support will never ask for it. Never type it into a website.
privateKey.autoHide: The key hides again after 30 seconds, when you leave this screen and when Muvo goes to the background. It can't be copied or captured in a screenshot.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.notConfigured: Error reporting is not set up in this build. Nothing is sent.
privacy.toggleDesc: Sends cleaned-up error reports to the CointMU server at {{host}}. Turning it off deletes the reports that have not been sent yet.
privacy.offline: The server is reachable only on the campus network. Elsewhere, reports wait on this phone (the newest {{count}}, for up to 30 days) and are sent when the server can be reached.

sent.stack: Where in the app it happened (stack trace)
sent.versions: App version and build, phone model and operating system version
sent.activity: The screens opened before the error and the app's own log lines, cleaned the same way

neverSent.secrets: Recovery phrases, private keys and your PIN
neverSent.screen: Screenshots, what is on the screen, and clipboard contents

notice.title: Error reports help us fix Muvo
notice.what: When something goes wrong, Muvo saves a report with the error, where in the app it happened, and the app and system versions. Recovery phrases, private keys, your PIN, wallet addresses and transaction hashes are removed first.
notice.where: Reports go to the CointMU server at {{host}}, which is reachable only on the campus network. Elsewhere they wait on this phone and are sent later.
notice.howToDisable: You can change this at any time in Settings > Privacy.

form.maxHint: Fills in the most you can send after the network fee

errors.invalid: That isn't a valid CointMU address.
errors.badChecksum: This address has a typo (its capital letters don't match). Check it and try again.

review.title: Review
review.tokenFeeNote: The fee is paid in CMU.
review.selfWarning: You are sending to your own address. You will only pay the network fee.
review.contractWarning: This address is a contract, not a personal wallet. Make sure it can receive this asset, or the funds may be lost.
review.authSubtitle: Your PIN signs this transaction on this device.
review.missing: This transfer is no longer available. Go back and start again.

result.sentBody: Your transaction is on its way. It shows as pending until it is mined, then confirmed, then final after 12 blocks.
result.uncertainBody: The network didn't answer in time, so it may or may not have the transaction. Muvo keeps checking. Don't send again until its status updates.

errors.insufficientFunds: Not enough balance for this amount plus the network fee.
errors.insufficientGas: Not enough CMU for the network fee. Token transfers pay their fee in CMU.
errors.balanceUnknown: Your balance hasn't loaded yet. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.nonceTooLow: Another transaction from this account was processed first. Go back and try again.
errors.underpriced: The network fee is too low right now. Try again to get a new fee.
errors.replacement: A transaction from this account is still pending. Wait for it to confirm, then try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the CointMU network right now. Check your connection and try again.
errors.wrongChain: The selected node is not on the CointMU network. Pick another node in Settings > Network.
errors.reverted: The network would reject this transfer (for a token, the contract refused it). Nothing was sent.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong and nothing was sent. Try again.

receive.title: Receive
receive.note: Only send CMU or CointMU tokens to this address. Coins from other networks sent here may be lost.

scan.title: Scan
scan.hint: Point the camera at a CointMU address or payment QR code. Nothing is sent until you review and confirm.

permission.title: Scan with your camera
permission.denied: Camera access is off for Muvo. Turn it on in your phone's settings to scan QR codes.
permission.why: Muvo uses the camera to scan QR codes of CointMU addresses and payment requests, so you don't have to type them.
permission.privacy: No photo or video is taken or stored. The camera runs only while this screen is open.
permission.next: Your phone will ask for permission next.

secret.title: Never share this code
secret.body: This QR code holds a recovery phrase or private key. Anyone who sees it can take your funds. Muvo did not keep it. Never show it to anyone or scan it into another app.

wrongChain.title: Different network
wrongChain.body: This request is for another blockchain. Muvo only sends on CointMU (chain {{chainId}}).

badChecksum.title: Address has a typo
badChecksum.body: The address in this code doesn't match its checksum. Ask for a new code.

invalidAddress.title: No valid address
invalidAddress.body: This code doesn't contain a valid CointMU address.

invalidAmount.title: Invalid amount
invalidAmount.body: The amount in this code can't be read. Ask for a new code.

unsupported.title: Not a payment code
unsupported.body: This QR code isn't a CointMU address or payment request.

unknownToken.title: Unknown token
unknownToken.body: This request is for a token that isn't in your list. Add the token first in Home > Manage, then scan again.

pinPrompt.error: Couldn't check the PIN. Please try again.
pinPrompt.mismatch: The PINs don't match. Start again.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.subtitle: Add a CointMU token by its contract address, or hide tokens you don't use.
tokens.unverifiedBody: Anyone can create a token with any name or symbol. Only add tokens you trust, and check the contract address with the project that issued it.
tokens.empty: No tokens yet. Add one with its contract address.

errors.invalidAddress: That isn't a valid contract address.
errors.badChecksum: This address has a typo (its capital letters don't match). Check it and try again.
errors.alreadyAdded: This token is already in your list.
errors.notContract: There is no contract at this address on CointMU.
errors.notToken: This contract doesn't look like a token (no symbol or decimals).
errors.network: Can't reach the CointMU network right now. Try again.

statusHelp.pending: Waiting to be included in a block.
statusHelp.confirmed: In a block. It becomes final after {{total}} blocks, because a recent block can still be undone.
statusHelp.final: Deep enough in the chain to be treated as settled.
statusHelp.failed: Included in a block but rejected by the contract. Only the network fee was spent.
statusHelp.dropped: The network no longer knows this transaction and it was never mined. Nothing was sent; you can send again.
statusHelp.replaced: Another transaction with the same nonce was mined instead. This one will never be mined.
